risks.description: Overall envelope 671.1 x 443.9 x approximately 309 mm exceeds the published vmc_3axis X/Y travels, so machining must use dedicated SPM fixtures, indexed setups, or qualified large-capacity partner support.
risks.mitigation: Use spm_milling_drilling with tool-room designed modular fixtures; verify actual machine envelope before order release.

risks.description: Several H7 holes, central bores, counterbores, pockets and section cavities have missing or partly legible depths/diameters.
risks.mitigation: Release route as provisional; obtain native CAD/released drawing values before CNC programming and fixture/gauge design.

risks.description: Large asymmetric 15CDV6 housing heat treated to 31-38 HRC can distort; H7 holes and precision bores must retain position after post-HT finishing.
risks.mitigation: Rough/semi-machine before HT, leave finishing stock on precision bores and datum surfaces, use controlled quench, and perform post-HT grinding/honing/verification.

risks.description: Shop profile lists in-house alkaline zinc plating; cadmium plating chemistry is specified but not explicitly confirmed.
risks.mitigation: Confirm whether plating_line is approved for cadmium 8-12 microns; otherwise qualify an outside cadmium plating supplier and hydrogen-embrittlement bake.
